Summary: Closed-lost; customer elected to self-host LLM stack (vLLM/TGI on Triton w/ TensorRT-LLM ops) after lengthy security review.

Timeline / activities:
- 2024-10-10: Intro call (AE Leah) — product fit looks good for low-latency teleop assistance. POC requested.
- 2024-11-02: POC scoping workshop — agreed on chat + telemetry summarization use-case, target p95 latency <120ms, 1k rps steady; cost model to compare hosted vs self-host.
- 2024-11-18: SE demo (Diego) — showed Dedicated throughput graphs, autoscaling options. Fireflies: ff_2025-08-19_nbra_prod-demo.
- 2024-12-02: Security questionnaire submitted; wanted KMS/HSM, full audit logging, data residency in NA, and air-gapped option for EU-manufacturing line.
- 2025-03-11: Security review call — heavy pushback on any SaaS outbound comms; legal flagged export controls for robotics firmware. Quote from Head of IT: 'We cannot accept external inference unless keys and data stay entirely on our fabric.'
- 2025-05-22: Internal procurement freeze for Opex; board approves CapEx for infra modernization (GPU bare metal).
- 2025-07-09: Engineering signals viable self-host path: vLLM + TGI for model server, Triton + TensorRT-LLM for kernel perf. Cost delta narrower after 3yr TCO; favors control.
- 2025-12-05: Final update: procurement signed purchase order for on-prem inference appliances. Redwood marked closed-lost.

POC notes / technical constraints:
- Required offline/air-gapped install for manufacturing sites.
- Must support hardware-accelerated kernels (TensorRT) and custom operator whitelist.
- KV-cache persistence across restarts is a hard requirement for long-horizon teleop sessions.
- Strict SLA on key management; customer will use HSM and their KMS.

Why lost: mixture of security policy + budget shift to CapEx + absence of internal champion after platform lead moved to new role. Also heavy preference for full control of model artifacts and quantization pipeline (TensorRT-LLM).

Open items for Redwood (follow-up playbook):
- Keep as watchlist: re-engage 6–12 months post-deployment to offer edge-validated private appliance or hybrid routing (on-prem primary, fallback to Redwood hosted in emergency).
- Send one-pager comparing hybrid model (private + hosted fallback) and HSM integration notes.
- Capture ask: sample Triton/TensorRT perf numbers for comparable model family (to repurpose in future conversations).
